task.title: Add documentation browser TreeView sections to sidebar
task.description: Add two new collapsible TreeView sections to the VSCode extension sidebar for browsing product and engineering documentation. Each section mirrors the folder structure of .kanban/product/ and .kanban/engineering/ respectively, allowing users to discover and open documentation files directly from the sidebar.
task.problem: Existing product and engineering documentation in the .kanban/ folder is difficult to discover. Users must manually navigate the file system or remember file paths to find relevant docs. There is no integrated way to browse available documentation while working on tasks.
task.value: Quick sidebar access to browse all product and engineering documentation while working. Improved discoverability of existing docs reduces duplicate documentation and knowledge gaps. Consistent with VSCode patterns - users expect sidebar trees for project navigation.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the user opens a workspace with .kanban/ folder And .kanban/product/ contains documentation files When the user expands the "Product Docs" section in the Kanban sidebar Then they see a tree structure mirroring the folder hierarchy And each markdown file appears as a clickable item
Given the user opens a workspace with .kanban/ folder And .kanban/engineering/ contains documentation files When the user expands the "Engineering Docs" section in the Kanban sidebar Then they see a tree structure mirroring the folder hierarchy And each markdown file appears as a clickable item
Given a documentation item is displayed in either tree When the user clicks on it Then the corresponding markdown file opens in the editor
Given the .kanban/product/ or .kanban/engineering/ folder is empty or missing When the user views the corresponding section Then the section shows an empty state or is hidden
